parsed.rationale: Both `AudioPlayerProtocol` and `PlaybackController` live in the same package (`Playback`) and the same directory (`Shared/Playback/Sources/PlaybackCore/Protocols/`), and they share six structurally identical or near-identical members: `installRenderTap:()`, `isPlaying:Bool`, `makeAudioBufferStream:() -> AsyncStream<AVAudioPCMBuffer>`, `removeRenderTap:()`, a `state` property, and a `stop` method. `AudioPlayerProtocol` represents the lower-level audio engine contract (it also exposes `eventStream`, `stateStream`, and a no-argument `play:()`), while `PlaybackController` is a higher-level orchestration contract that adds `isLoading`, `toggle`, and a richer `play:(reason:)` / `stop:(reason:)` surface. Making `PlaybackController` inherit from `AudioPlayerProtocol` (or a common base extracted from both) would eliminate the duplicated member declarations and make the layering explicit. Neither record carries any restraint marker (`is_test`, `is_mock`, `is_sample_app`, `is_codegen` are all false), so no restraint rule applies.
